text: The Collective Agreement between the Board and Labourers' International Union of North America, Local 506 ("LiUNA Local 506") expired on March 31, 2018. Notice to Bargain was received from LiUNA on February 22, 2018. Prior to commencing bargaining, the parties agreed to try and resolve issues that were at arbitration. These efforts were unsuccessful. On September 26, 2018 the union filed for conciliation with the Ministry of Labour. Following the appointment of a conciliator, bargaining meetings were held on April 8, 2019, April 16, 2019, May 2, 2019, June 5, 2019, July 3, 2019 and July 30, 2019 (into July 31, 2019) with LiUNA Local 506, City Labour Relations staff, Exhibition Place staff and the Ministry of Labour Conciliator. This report outlines the terms of a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) negotiated with LiUNA Local 506. These terms which are set out in the confidential attachment…

Authorized staff to make the necessary amendments to rates of pay, benefits and other issues identified as agreed changes to the collective agreement in the Memorandum of Agreement (Confidential Schedule A) and set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 1, 2019) from the Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary, Exhibition Place. 3.
